parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bank-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 640 | 5.21 | 5.21
2 | 934 | 8.58 | 13.8
3 | 2594 | 84.1 | 97.9
4 | 4386 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bank-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: 13.8 m – 97.9 m (with a deeper, more resistive aquiferous zone below 97.9 m)
Recommendation: Target the main water-bearing zone between 13.8 m and 97.9 m (high-resistivity sand/gravel layer), but plan for possible deeper screening beyond 97.9 m where resistivity increases further, indicating a potentially more productive confined aquifer; ensure casing is set through the upper low-resistivity layers to avoid cross-contamination.
